name: Warehouse Demand Forecasting Model
description: A machine-learning model that forecasts weekly demand per product (SKU) per warehouse to help planners set reorder quantities. Planners review and adjust the forecast before any purchase order is created.
documentation:
DATA: aggregated historical sales per SKU per warehouse, promotions calendar, public holidays (Ramadan, Eid, national day). No customer or employee personal data.
MODEL: gradient-boosted trees trained in-house; hosted on the company's in-Kingdom cloud tenant.
HUMAN OVERSIGHT: forecasts are suggestions in the planning dashboard; purchase orders are created and approved by planners under existing approval limits.
ACCURACY: back-tested on 24 months (MAPE 11%); monthly accuracy report; retraining monthly with drift alert if MAPE exceeds 18%.
ACCESS: planners and supply-chain managers only via RBAC.
LOGGING: model versions and forecast runs logged.
